literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe a single experimental modality: C-terminal eGFP fused to full-length FCAR variant 1 via pEGFP-N3 (which places GFP at the C-terminus of the insert). FCAR is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein with its large N-terminal domain extracellular (residues 22–227), a single TM helix (228–246), and a short C-terminal cytoplasmic tail (247–287). A C-terminal GFP therefore sits on the intracellular face — explicitly confirmed by L1 ('C-terminal GFP after the TM/C domain'). L2 and L3 confirm that the tagged protein reaches the plasma membrane, but this reports trafficking of the full-length protein, not extracellular display of the GFP moiety. L4 provides cloning details consistent with an intracellular C-terminal tag. No ledger line reports a tag inserted into the extracellular domain (residues 22–227), at the mature N-terminus (after residue 21), or in any extracellular loop. The ledger therefore supports zero extracellular surface tag sites.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal eGFP fused after residue 287 (last residue of the intracellular tail); protein traffics to the plasma membrane but the GFP faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
